name: Object-Store Credentials
description: Mounted at /api/v1/storage (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only; JSON exists only as the client's own sealed-envelope body and, on request, the responder's rendering). The ONE http trigger delivers the $HTQ request to storage/credentials serve, which matches /credentials/<store>: GET answers whether the lane storage_<store> holds a credential plus the node's X25519 wrapping key (a one-row $QRP page; the browser seals {username: access key id, secret: secret access key} to it), PUT opens the browser-sealed envelope with the host's keyslot oracle (keyslot.unwrap, gated by wallet_sign) and stores it with secrets.put, DELETE clears it with secrets.clear, answered the same whether or not a credential was held. serve answers through foundation/http-respond respond_query. This flow is the ONLY holder of the secrets WRITE grant for the storage lanes; storage/object-s3 holds the READ grant alone. Every route is NOT anonymous (an admin session): an anonymous visitor overwriting a node's store credentials would redirect what every flow on the node writes. There is no plaintext branch and no route that reads a credential back. The host owns no store list, no schedule and no secret semantics - it mounts a route and moves bytes; zero new capabilities.

triggers.description: The ONE http trigger: one $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per exchange; PATH dispatch happens in-wasm (serve).

api.tagDescription: Object-store credentials for this node's storage modules (R2, S3, B2, MinIO, Wasabi, GCS interoperability).

routes.summary: Whether a store credential is held, and the key to seal one to
routes.description: Answers a one-row $QRP projection page (store, credentialLane, credentialConfigured, checked, keySlotId, keySlotPublicKey as raw bytes - base64 in the Json representation, keySlotAlgorithm X25519). Presence only; the value is never readable. NOT ANONYMOUS.

params.name: store
params.description: The store name: 1-24 characters of a-z, 0-9, _. The lane is storage_<store>.

routes.summary: Store a browser-sealed object-store credential in the node's credential store
routes.description: Takes the node's own keyslot envelope (the client's JSON {slotId, ephemeralPublicKey, nonce, ciphertext}; the plaintext is {username: access key id, secret: secret access key}), asks the host to open it (keyslot.unwrap) and writes the result to the machine-bound credential store (secrets.put) under the lane storage_<store>. The value is never echoed, logged or readable back through any route; the answer is a one-row $QRP projection (store, credentialLane, credentialConfigured, stored). NOT ANONYMOUS. There is no plaintext branch.

params.name: store
params.description: The store name; the lane written is storage_<store>, derived by the module, never a lane name the caller supplies.

routes.description: Removes the storage_<store> lane (secrets.clear). Answers the same one-row $QRP projection whether or not anything was there. NOT ANONYMOUS.
